component.name: Viby
component.summary: A modern, minimal, aesthetic local music player

description.p: Viby is a fast, elegant, lightweight local music player designed for high-fidelity audio playback. It features clean liquid glass aesthetics, a compact MiniPlayer, an immersive Theater Mode, and native GNOME desktop integration.

ul.li: Pure-Rust audio decoding: FLAC, Opus, AAC, ALAC, MP3, Vorbis, WAV, AIFF
Compact liquid-glass MiniPlayer with floating controls
Immersive full-screen Theater Mode with live audio visualizer
Parametric 10-band Equalizer with oversampling and AutoEQ import
Native GNOME MPRIS media controls, Quick Settings integration, and dock quicklists
Discord Rich Presence with live track status

description.p: Initial release with pure-Rust audio engine, Opus support, MiniPlayer, Theater Mode, and GNOME integration.
